note: A real trained checkpoint exists (verified: genuine ultralytics.nn.tasks.DetectionModel structure with real Conv2d/BatchNorm2d weight tensors, not a placeholder). It cannot be loaded directly, though: this AI microservice runs on plain Node.js with no Python/PyTorch runtime, and .pt is a Python-pickle format. The service already supports a real classifier via ONNX_MODEL_PATH (see ai/src/models.js loadModels()) -- export the checkpoint to ONNX (`yolo export model=safaai_best.pt format=onnx`, needs Python + ultralytics, e.g. a free Google Colab notebook), upload the resulting .onnx file, and point ONNX_MODEL_PATH at it. No other code change needed. Until then, classify() runs its documented deterministic stand-in.
